title: Cultural and education workers’ demonstration against cultural-sector budget cuts
location: Before the Riigikogu, Toompea Hill, Tallinn
scope: Tallinn gathering; nationwide coordination not established
organizer: Called by Eesti Teatriliit; cultural workers, creative-sector representatives and education workers
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous headcount reported; the 109 photos in one gallery are not a participant count.

occurrence.evidence: ERR and the association describe a public picket before the Riigikogu on 15 October; association identifies Eesti Teatriliit as caller.

date.evidence: ERR caption and association text give 15 October 2024.

location.evidence: Before the Riigikogu on Toompea Hill, Tallinn.

state_target.evidence: Opposed the cultural sector’s share of state budget cuts and sought debate over Estonia’s culture-budget allocation.

threshold_50.evidence: No source gives a people count; “109 photos” is a gallery image count, not attendance.

notes: Public gathering and own-state budget demand are supported; the minimum 50 simultaneous attendees are not. September’s cited action is a distinct prior event, not continuation.
open_questions: Was the action a nationally coordinated campaign or a Tallinn picket?

title: Students’ rally supporting free higher education and merit scholarships
scope: Tallinn rally; students described as from across Estonia, national organization not otherwise established
organizer: School and university students; Federation of Estonian Student Unions (EÜL) statement
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance count; rally described as students from across Estonia but not numerically.

occurrence.evidence: ERR reports students rallied outside Stenbock House; government transcript search output also mentions the visit.

state_target.evidence: Students addressed the Estonian government, supporting free higher education and merit scholarships in state policy/budget.

notes: Actual state-directed public rally is supported; ≥50 simultaneous participants are unproven. A minister briefly visited, but no accommodation is inferred.
open_questions: How many students were simultaneously present?
Was the rally nationally organized by EÜL?

title: Jätku leiba! coordinated hospitality-sector tax protest / work stoppage
location: Multiple restaurants, cafes and accommodation facilities across Estonia; full venue list unknown
scope: Nationwide coordinated multi-site action led by EHRL; qualifying public-gathering form unresolved
organizer: Estonian Hotel and Restaurant Association (EHRL), hospitality establishments and staff
threshold_50_evidence: Venue counts are not attendee counts; reporting describes a service pause at workplaces, not a countable assembly.

occurrence.evidence: ERR describes a 12:30–12:40 nationwide action in which venues stopped service; EHRL announced it; Lääne Elu describes nine venues in Lääne County.

location.evidence: Across Estonia in participating venues; local reporting identifies nine Lääne businesses including a Haapsalu pub.

state_target.evidence: Organizers protested rising state taxes/VAT and called for a more sustainable tax environment.

threshold_50.evidence: 360+ venues were officially joined and dozens of venues stopped service; Lääne reporting says nine local venues. Establishments are not people and no simultaneous person count or gathering is shown.

notes: Nationwide policy protest and coordinated timing are supported. Whether it was a qualifying public gathering and whether ≥50 people participated simultaneously are unresolved.
open_questions: Did staff assemble publicly at venues or only stop work?
How many people were simultaneously participating across sites?
Does the multi-site work stoppage meet the public-gathering rule?
